meta.why: athletics_sites.json mirrors ncaa.com's school pages, and ncaa.com carries a STALE athletics URL for these schools (it still lists suathletics.com for Syracuse, buffalobulls.com for Buffalo). Two entries were also malformed with a doubled scheme. Corrected here rather than in athletics_sites.json so the mirrored file stays a faithful record of what ncaa.com says.
meta.verification: A corrected domain is only accepted if the roster it yields OVERLAPS that team's own 2025 box-score names. A domain that resolves proves nothing; a roster full of the right people does.
